_comment_: 128 x 128 x 64 cells at dx=dy=10 m, dz=1 m (1280 x 1280 x 64 m), stored whole; the training dataset takes one random 64 x 64 x 32 window per volume (crop_windows.py; z offset 1-31 so the engine's floor and roof, where the level ladder is anchored, never coincide with a window edge). Design: DeltaLayer in distributary-tree mode (bifurcate=true: discharge split at every bifurcation, width ~ Q^0.5, depth ~ Q^0.4, mouth bars, prograding front), channel depth 3-16 m log-uniform, n_generations from a sampled aggradation ratio with the bottom generation's base on the floor, correlated porosity texture inside sand.

grid._comment_dx_: 128 x 128 x 64 cells at dx=dy=10 m, dz=1 m (1280 x 1280 x 64 m), stored whole; the training dataset takes one random 64 x 64 x 32 window per volume (z offset 1-31 so the engine's floor and roof, where the level ladder is anchored, never coincide with a window edge). dx=dy=10m, dz=1m. Distributaries are ~56m wide -> 5-6 cells (W:D=14, depth=4m). Migration step ~3m -> 0.3 cells/event. 8 generations x 4m channel depth fills 32m vertically; widen z_len if you bump n_generations or mCHdepth.

trunk_length_fraction._comment_: VARIED. Fraction of proximal streamline nodes protected from avulsion (i.e. trunk length before fan branches). DELTA_FAN baseline 0.4. 0.2 = early bifurcation (broad fan), 0.6 = long trunk.

progradation_fraction._comment_: VARIED. Per-generation trunk-length advance (apex moves toward +flow as levels stack). DELTA_FAN baseline 0.0 (no progradation). >0 gives clinoform signature.

n_generations._comment_: AUTO. Same aggradation-ratio rule as the channels: DeltaLayer anchors the bottom generation's base on the floor, so n = round((64 - depth) / (r * depth)) + 1.

ntime_per_gen._comment_: unused in tree mode (kept for a uniform row schema).

mFFCHprop._comment_: VARIED. Fraction of abandoned distributary filled with mud. DELTA_FAN baseline 0.0 (sand-rich tails — visible distributary ribbons). >0 begins to mute the distributaries.

mouth_bar_length_factor._comment_: VARIED. Bar length relative to the channel width at the tip (bars sit at every channel end and every split).

mouth_bar_hw_ratio._comment_: skip — class default. Bar thickness above channel / width.

mouth_bar_dw_ratio._comment_: skip — class default. Bar scour-depth below channel / width.

probAvulOutside._comment_: skip — preset default. Override of class 0.10 -> 0.0 (no out-of-belt avulsions in delta — trunks always start at boundary).

probAvulInside._comment_: unused in tree mode (kept for a uniform row schema).

stdevCHsinu._comment_: skip — preset default. Override of class 0.15 -> 0.02 (tight sinuosity distribution).

stdevCHdepth._comment_: skip — preset default. Override of class 0.4 -> 0.5.

stdevCHwdratio._comment_: skip — preset default. Override of class 1.0 -> 2.0.

mCHdepth._comment_: VARIED. Channel depth (m), log-uniform so 3-8 m stays as common as 8-16 m; 16 m = half the column, two levels at least.

stdevCHsource._comment_: skip — preset default. Override of class 80 -> 0.2 (tight, dead-centre feeder source — single trunk entry).

stdevCHazi._comment_: skip — preset default. Override of class 1.0 -> 0.2.

mdistMigrate._comment_: unused in tree mode (kept for a uniform row schema).

stdevdistMigrate._comment_: skip — preset default. Override of class 10 -> 1.

mNeckFFCHprop._comment_: skip — class default. Neck-cutoff plug only used by MEANDER_OXBOW.

mLVdepth._comment_: skip — preset default. Override of class 1.0 -> 0.5 (small natural levees on distributaries).

stdevLVdepth._comment_: skip — preset default. Override of class 0.2 -> 0.1.

mLVwidth._comment_: skip — preset default. Override of class 40 -> 20.

mLVheight._comment_: skip — preset default. Override of class 0.5 -> 0.3.

mLVasym._comment_: skip — preset default. Override of class 0.3 -> 0.0 (symmetric levees).

stdevCSnum._comment_: skip — preset default. Override of class 0.5 -> 0.

Cf._comment_: skip — preset default. Override of class 0.0078 -> 0.0036.

scour_factor._comment_: skip — preset default. Override of class 2.0 -> 10.0.

bifurcate._comment_: tree mode; false = the single-channel avulsion-history delta.

n_trees._comment_: VARIED. Networks per generation (the level's avulsion history).

n_bifurcations._comment_: VARIED. Splits per network; 5-20 in an 800 m box, scaled by the 1.6x longer box edge.

split_frac_hi._comment_: child's share of the parent discharge is U(split_frac_lo, split_frac_hi): splits are unequal, 25/75 to 50/50.

branch_angle_mean._comment_: VARIED. Launch angle of a branch from its parent, degrees.

branch_length_scale._comment_: VARIED. Only terminal channels (share below q_min) stop by length: this x diagonal x sqrt(Q).

max_splits_per_branch._comment_: VARIED. Branches one segment can give off: 2 = binary tree, 4 = several primaries off the trunk (Wax Lake).

q_min._comment_: VARIED. Branches below this discharge share never split (sets how many orders the tree has).

merge_branches._comment_: VARIED. Branches that run into another join it (tidal-lattice look) or stop.

split_pos_exp._comment_: VARIED. 1 = splits anywhere along a segment, 2.5 = near its upstream end.

branch_relax._comment_: VARIED. How far a branch eases back from its launch angle toward the regional slope (0 keeps diverging).

front_radius._comment_: VARIED. Base front distance from the apex in box lengths: below 1 the front is inside the cube (lobes, bars, prodelta beyond), above 1 the cube is plain and channels run to its edges. It progrades with progradation_fraction.

front_bulge._comment_: VARIED. How much further a big channel progrades than a small one: 0.1 smooth arcuate front, 0.6 bird's foot.

poro_noise_std._comment_: VARIED. Relative std of a correlated porosity texture inside sand cells; perm follows via the K-C slope. 0 = smooth ramp.

poro_noise_range._comment_: VARIED. Lateral correlation length of that texture in cells (20-80 m); vertical is a third.

_comment_shard_size_: 32: the writer buffers a whole shard in memory and a 128 x 128 x 64 sample is 6 MB, so 1000 samples would be 6 GB per rank and 144 ranks would need 860 GB on a 237 GB node. 32 samples = 192 MB per rank.
